description: Deterministic golden conformance vector manifest for Bind ParserSpec runtimes (Mesh, TypeScript, ClickHouse SQL, Swift).

suites.description: Golden conformance vectors covering word (including default class), int, and float hole classes with boundary values, overlapping literals, and overflow semantics.
Golden conformance vectors covering uuid, hex, ip (IPv4 and IPv6), and time (ISO 8601, Apache, syslog) hole classes including overlapping-literal boundaries.
Golden conformance vectors covering quoted, json (with SQL refusal tags), until (before all literal kinds), and rest hole classes.

Golden conformance vectors covering cast, scale (IEEE-754 single-op bit patterns), unit (all time and byte units), parse_time (all 10 formats including exact decimal unix_s), lower (locale-independent UTF-8), and enum_map transforms.

Golden conformance vectors covering hash, mask (token and ip_prefix), drop, known redaction tokens across all 11 hole classes and field types, neutral unknown angle-bracket strings, and explicit PII transform placement.
Golden conformance vectors covering object (pure, nested, optional paths, message sub-patterns, SQL-refused message json holes) and args matchers.
Golden conformance vectors covering canonical order.paid example, adjacent holes, UTF-8 non-ASCII cases (U+00A0, U+3000, combining marks, emoji), 64 KiB boundary records, and multi-field isolation.
